subject: t-c-imp
title: T.C.IMP.------EXP.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 495 (MP(II)-13). T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the subject; EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), OBS (observation) and DEC (decentralization). From TR: UNF-PI (unification (positively intended)). From OBS: BSCI. From DEC: MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis). From UNF-PI: C-CONT (composite continuance). From BSCI: FUND-DY (fundamental dynamics) and POST (postulation). From MT-IF-DB: PRI-INFO (principle information).
